notes.title: Christmas update
notes.notes:
Another year is approaching and festivities are all around us. On behalf of our entire creative team, we want to wish you and all those around you: a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year! That we wish you may spend a lot of precious time with those you love and cherish in one of the coziest times of the year. 

To help you get even more in a festive mood, we have added Christmas decorations to the game and added a small quest where you can earn yourself a unique and rare gift: a potion to redistribute your skill points. So be sure to use it wisely! 

We're also happy to announce the release of even more related content: soundtracks and a digital artbook, where we've collected a variety of sketches, photos and more! All which are used in the game.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2247910/Force_of_Nature_2__Collectors_Pack/
We certainly hope you enjoy this exciting new content to the fullest! 

Happy Holidays everyone!

notes.title: Halloween Update for Force of Nature 2: Ghost Keeper
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40531452/705fc13b15755c677c31ed8f0ccab322859168d8.jpg

Join us for the ultimate Halloween in-game event on October 25, 2022 for Steam Scream Fest with plenty of spirits, spooky decor, sweet treats, and more! 

New Quest
Partake in a special holiday quest featuring ghosts! You must go through a number of ghosts to “kill” them and, when you’ve killed a certain amount, you will receive an exclusive pumpkin helmet as a spooky reward! 

New Seasonal Decor
Looking to add some ghoulish glamour to your home? We have some spooktacular Halloween decorations you can use that include:

 A ghostly scarecrow
 Bush that looks like a witch
 Halloween style environmental objects


New Interactive Items
We’ve also included a few gourd-themed interactive items such as:

 Pumpkins for players to throw
 Pumpkin juice
 Pumpkin pie


We hope that this in-game event, decorations, and interactive items help you to ring in Halloween!

notes.title: Update 1.0.18
notes.notes:
Added Latin Spanish localization
Added animations for stunned state of the main hero

Arrows and darts now have a chance to be dropped as a loot after each shot

notes.title: Update 1.0.17
notes.notes:
Hero can now automatically retaliate against enemy attacksIf you stand still and you're under attack, the hero will start hitting back. You can disable this options in the settings.

Also:Reduced the required stamina points for Berserk, Critical strike, Dash, Sprint and Block
Amount of enemies on the Tropical Island has been reduced by 20%
Experience gained for killing enemies of the Tropical Island has been increased by 20% (to compensate the decreased amount of enemies)
Increased amount of scrap dropped from killing turtles and metal knights
The damage received from the cannons of the pirate boss fight has been decreased from 40 to 25 per hit

notes.title: Update 1.0.16
notes.notes:
Added more options for you to configure the difficulty of the game to your liking.

There are 3 settings in total:Simplified combat - enemies have less health and their attacks deal less damage
Faster crafting - duration of all recipes is significantly reduced
Increased inventory - inventory size increased by 8 additional slotsThey can be set individually.

You can also change these settings for existing save games in three simple steps: click "CONTINUE" in the main menu, select a game and in the lower left corner click "Change game mode".

Now each player can more accurately adjust the difficulty of the game for themselves!

notes.title: Update 1.0.14

New content:
MannequinThe mannequin can be dressed in different clothes. You can also change the pose.

Bamboo boomerang
Obsidian boomerangBoomerang is a ranged weapon that does not require ammo. It deals damage to all enemies in its path. (AoE)

Sparkling сopper hammer

Other:

notes.title: Update 1.0.13
notes.notes:
Reduced size of the seedbed window
Fertilizers moved from the additional window into the main seedbed window
Added hotkey for the "Plant" button (by default it is P)
Now it will be much easier to plant crops in the seedbeds - just click on the seedbed (right mouse button if moving by mouse, left mouse button if moving by keys), and press P

Added button to call tamed animal - the animal will come close to you
Now it will be much easier to drive animals into pens

Attack speed for all melee weapons (Axes, Picks, Cudgel, Swords, Spears, Maces, Torches) increased by 20%
Usage speed for Jug, Buckets, Hoes and Shovels increased by 10%
Increased amount of health for all bosses by 10% (to compensate for the increased attack speed of the main hero)
Reduced cooldowns for all active skills
Blowgun base damage incresed from 6 to 7

notes.title: Update 1.0.12
notes.notes:
Added WASD control! You can move the character via keys now (by default WASD)
You can setup 2 separate keymaps in settings - one for moving via mouse clicking and another for moving via keyboard, and easily switch between 2 types of control.

Also
You can restore health and stamina on the bed without respawning enemies now
You can choose where to respawn enemies now: only at the current location or at all locations
Added more variations of animations for small wildlife
Saltpeter production now takes 90 seconds instead of 120
